what_this_is: A first-party signed price feed, live on Base Sepolia. The provider signs (chainId, contract, feedId, price, publishTime); the chain verifies against a pinned key set; the relayer becomes a courier who cannot alter what they carry.
trust_level_is_NOT_the_same_as_the_other: Pyth, Chainlink and API3 are networks whose own operators sign. Here the reporter keys are OURS, so the chain confirms that MISHARU signed a number — not that Kraken or Coinbase said it. The DATA is genuinely independent of the oracle networks; the ATTESTATION is only as good as this project. For a real deployment the reporter keys belong to the provider, and then the chain is confirming something nobody here can forge.
why_it_is_not_in_the_production_aggregat: Adding it beside three networks would make four sources look like four independent opinions when one of them is ours. The mechanism is proven; the independence is not, and the difference matters more than the count.
proven_on_chain: a signed price reads back unchanged
a relayer altering the price is refused
a relayer restamping the time is refused
one signature where two are required is refused
